integrity: The upper bound is an exact computer-assisted polynomial proof. A continuous relaxation of the published integer recurrence is covered by rational tensor-product Bernstein certificates, and the integer-alphabet comparison is reduced to five explicit residue-class polynomials. The included verifier reconstructs every certificate from exact arithmetic.
scientific_limitations: The theorem treats fixed codeword length 6 and alphabet sizes q>=10. It does not classify or enumerate all maximum codes, prove an analogue for other lengths, or claim new finite values below q=10.
title: Blackburn's construction is optimal for all length-\(6\) codes once \(q\ge10\)
